discovery.sentence: Cipla's North America revenue has grown for three consecutive quarters while its lanreotide line stayed paused on a partner facility issue, a gap the company's own narrative does not separate out.
why_it_matters: The headline US growth number hides a product-level supply risk tied to a named partner site.
A partner facility dependency is not visible from Cipla's own disclosures alone.
If the partner site issue resolves, the growth rate could accelerate further.
If it does not resolve within two quarters, US growth could decelerate sharply.

anchor.quote: North America revenue of $162 Mn during the quarter

discovery.counterargument: Industry-wide US pricing pressure explains some of the growth deceleration risk, not only the partner facility issue.

falsification.statement: North America revenue growth below 0 percent for two consecutive quarters would contradict this finding

claims.text: North America revenue was $162 million in Q1 FY27
